explanation: Assignment operators in C are used to assign values to variables.  They take a value on the right-hand side and store it into the variable on the left-hand side.  This is fundamental for manipulating data within a C program.

extraction_metadata.source: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie

book: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie
code_example:
/* Compound Assignment Operators */

int x = 10;
int y = 5;

x += y;   // x is 15 (x = x + y)
x -= y;   // x is 10 (x = x - y)
x *= y;   // x is 50 (x = x * y)
x /= y;   // x is 10 (x = x / y)
x %= 3;   // x is 1  (x = x % 3)

x = 10;
x &= 7;   // x is 2  (x = x & 7) (10 & 7 == 1010 & 0111 == 0010)
x |= 1;   // x is 3
x ^= 4;   // x is 7

x <<= 2;  // x is 28
x >>= 1;  // x is 14
keywords: assignment operator, operator=, variable assignment, C variable assignment
